attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Animated Armor
description: The armor is just a shell — it’s the vines that are actually living. Infused with pieces of Murmurwood Mycelium, these beings have simple sort of mind and sometimes even personalities, though they’re nigh incomprehensible to ordinary mortals.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
movement_description: Teleports directly to destination hex, ignoring obstacles and traps.
name: Avatar
description: There is a unique mastery invented by Jadame scholars, an art of expressing one’s soul not through word or song, but directly. The creature cast this way is a uniquely tremulous and powerful Embodiment.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Couatl
description: These feathered serpents oftentimes rely on their sheer power, hailing back to older, more primal times. Their scales make them impervious to spells that alter one’s essence.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Red Dragon
description: Usually these dragons roam the Garrote Gorge, but lately, more and more of them have been sighted across Central Jadame.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Faun
description: The fauns of the Murmurwoods remain a mystery to most outsiders. They shun complex tools, instead embracing symbiosis with the forest — trusting that the Mycelium will provide everything they need.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Swordsman
description: The Church of the Sun brought their faith to Jadame in the only way they knew how to — through steel. Their well-armed and disciplined swordsmen serve as both proselytes and guardians of the Chalice’s flock.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Guard Captain
description: All Templars are believers, but some prioritize military tradition over religious doctrine. The Arm of the Sun is an order that unites those who seek enlightenment through combat prowess rather than inquisitorial teachings.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Peasant
description: The backbone of every kingdom’s economy, peasants work the fields and pay taxes. Just don’t ask if they voted for you.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Pixie
description: Born from flower buds blossoming in mana-rich places, Pixies are mischievous beings who cherish free will and playfulness over laws or others’ well-being. Though akin to faeries, they pledge loyalty to no one, following only those who promise excitement.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Skeleton Archer
description:
Skeletal archers are rather uncommon among the necromancers; however, vampires especially value them as castle guards.

After all, it is always easier to repel would-be assailants from afar.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Cavalry
description: If templar infantry is the anvil, these cavaliers are the hammer of the inquisitorial forces. Mounted on sturdy steeds, they charge into battle, inspiring their troops while wreaking havoc in enemy ranks.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Sunspear Cavalry
description: Clad in the finest armor a knight can wield, these equine lords serve as the Sun’s spear, shattering ranks and growing in power with each prayer uttered in their name. Chalice be their witness!

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Ghoul
description: I’ve heard it’s actually the grief from the loss of his lovely piglet that made him like this.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
movement_description: Teleports directly to destination hex, ignoring obstacles and traps.
name: Vernal Naiad
description:
To most in Jadame, water is both the source of life and the veil of oblivion. A hand soothed in water forgets its scratch, and a leap over a stream lifts one’s gloom.

To a vernal naiad, it is a pure joy to take such worries away.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
movement_description: Teleports directly to destination hex, ignoring obstacles and traps.
name: Infiltrator
description: The elven spies of Alvar, these long-time surface dwellers had to adapt when they began expanding their cities into the underground. They now view subterfuge as the key to gaining an advantage.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
movement_description: Teleports directly to destination hex, ignoring obstacles and traps.
name: Bleak Infiltrator
description: Bleak Infiltrators are deployed in areas where Triumvirate’s influence is weak and their presence must remain hidden. The nature of their tasks often leaves them individualistic and isolated.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Austringer
description: Austringers and their falcons possess razor-sharp instincts, striking in perfect unison at a single call. This rare bond makes them invaluable to the Temple’s forces — though some zealots question the purity of their souls.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Halfling
description: A cheerful and friendly people who are lucky enough to be native to Jadame. Or maybe luck is the only thing that helps them survive here, seeing how they’re neither cruel nor particularly sly.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Enemies do not counterattack.
name: Hydra
description:
Native to underground rivers and Duskmire Swamps, hydras are creatures of immense power. Legend claims that cutting off one of their heads only invites three more to the feast.

And the main course? Why, it’s you, naturally.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Kittenhorn
description: These cute, cat-like creatures are actually quite ancient. They hail back from the times when crystals had minds and songs could change reality. Kittenhorns carry a bit of those primordial times with themselves still, occasionally driving people insane — be it through glee or rage.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Lich Dragon
description: Undead dragons come to existence in places where enormous amounts of necrotic energies radiate close to their resting places. As such, for all the power they have, risen dragons are surprisingly simple and unambitious — more beasts guarding their graveyards than rulers.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Lightweaver
description: One of the scriptures of the Church proclaims, “The Sun is a chalice into which all human souls flow after death. To truly empower it, one must seek enlightenment and self-discipline.” Lightweavers help the faithful achieve this, guiding them in rituals that foster clarity and spiritual strength.

attack_description: Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
name: Medusa
description:
The role of Medusae in Alvari society is an odd one. Being true natives of the underworld, many of them harbor resentment toward collaborating with “surfacers” and their ways of life.

Is their involvement born of curiosity, or is there an ulterior motive for their interest in the surface?

attack_description: Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
name: Medusa Queen
description:
Rumors speak of a chthonic lifeform thrives deep below the passages explored by the Triumvirate, with all medusae as its kin — but only the gorgons hold the truth.

If these tales are more than a myth, one must wonder — who do these “Queens” truly serve?

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Phoenix
description:
Phoenixes are not native to Jadame but travelers who entered the land willingly. Nesting deep within the forest, they display remarkable intelligence.

It is said that a single spark of flame is enough to bring them back to life.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Concubus
description: For Schism followers who crave power, the Rift offers an irreversible transformation. Once this course is chosen, those who are reborn by the process must maintain focus, or else risk becoming a gateway themselves.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Unicorn
description: Unicorns, beings of Light Magic, possess supernatural intelligence and strength. Telepathic and elusive, they dwell in hidden Murmurwood groves, revealing themselves only to the pure of heart. Through centuries of interaction, elves have sometimes earned their alliance, but unicorns are slow to trust and never forgive betrayal.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Sun's Aegis
description:
Those who believe in the power of the Chalice without question are imbued with the Sun’s strength, utterly convinced that their devotion to the Church will one day lead them to ascend as angels.

A bit strange, if not ambitious.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Menacing Reaver
description: Resilient beyond mortal limits and capable of obliterating everything with its many claws, these reavers terrify both Alvarians and Templars alike. Its high intelligence and relentless thirst for blood make it a truly daunting foe.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Scorpion
description: One of the most vicious creatures of the Hive, Scorpions exist at the blurry line between insectoid and demon. These highly adaptable creatures use basic tactics to herd their prey into inescapable passages, ensuring their capture.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Spelaean Scorpion
description: Spelaean scorpions were once a rare sight for those who dwell on the surface, as they inhabit only the darkest corners of the Jadame caverns. However, even if you have encountered these small but defensive critters before, I have one piece of advice should you ever face this monstrosity infused with the Hive’s magic: run.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Volcanic Scorpion
description: As a scholar, I rarely find myself at risk of personal harm while traveling across Jadame. An encounter with a volcanic scorpion and its incredible speed certainly tested that long held sense of security.

attack_description: Has an attack that targets the hex directly behind an adjacent hex. It doesn’t provoke counterattacks and doesn’t move the attacker next to their target.
name: Parasite
description: Parasites are an easy — but nonetheless horrendous — way to create the Hive’s foot soldiers. Attaching themseves to unfortunate passersby, they gain a sturdy, disposable host. Although the host does not possess exceptional agility, it still allows the parasites to be effective in melee, while their own bodies are predisposed to engage the enemy at short distance.

attack_description: Has an attack that targets the hex directly behind an adjacent hex. It doesn’t provoke counterattacks and doesn’t move the attacker next to their target.
name: Ravager Parasite
description: Parasites evolve into ravagers for the sole purpose of sowing chaos and disorder among the Hive’s victims. Their cerci prove especially deadly against those who would underestimate their vicious strikes.

attack_description: Has an attack that targets the hex directly behind an adjacent hex. It doesn’t provoke counterattacks and doesn’t move the attacker next to their target.
name: Warden Parasite
description: When the need arises, warden parasites are dispatched to safeguard the swarm during raids on nearby settlements. Singular in purpose, they rely on their overwhelming numbers to keep reinforcements at bay.

attack_description: Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
name: Worldwatcher
description: These constructs often accompany sentinels — perhaps they are made by them. They claim their mission is simply to observe the world and report to their makers, to see if anything needs to be fixed. But why are simple observers so well equipped for battle?

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Wight
description: A person once deeply cherished, forced back to life against their will. Wights, dissolving and lost, claw at the memories of others in desperation, hoping to recover — or steal — their names and identities.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Phantasm
description: Souls severed from their bodies succumb to entropy, flickering and fading as they desperately cling to fragments of identity while oblivion slowly consumes them.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Enemies do not counterattack.
name: Chthonic Hydra
description: Rumors speak a of slow chthonic life form slithering in the deepest, darkest corners of Enroth, patiently waiting. Hydras that descend into these depths become far more resilient than their kin, with uncanny awareness of their surroundings.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Enemies do not counterattack.
name: Infernal Hydra
description: A scholar once claimed that hydras are made of the earth itself. True or not, some hydras emerge with scarlet scales and crystalline barbs adorning their bodies. Their bite delivers a venom that saps strength, leaving their prey helpless.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
movement_description: Teleports directly to destination hex, ignoring obstacles and traps.
name: Waurms
description: Waurmos were once known as semi-intelligent creatures roaming the Ironsand Desert. It broke my heart to discover they had all become corrupted, now serving as the Hive’s siege breakers.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
movement_description: Teleports directly to destination hex, ignoring obstacles and traps.
name: Devourer
description: Marked by the demonic corruption, some waurmos developed hardened scales and a fiery crown. Any traveler should beware, for these monstrous creatures are capable of swallowing entire patrols whole.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Bewitcher
description:
Can you imagine being born an ordinary mortal — only to become something else, something greater?

It’s no wonder some bewitchers seek — and earn — admiration in every gaze.

attack_description: Has an attack that targets the hex directly behind an adjacent hex. It doesn’t provoke counterattacks and doesn’t move the attacker next to their target.
name: Cultist
description: Although Lyssara’s expedition to the Sea of Regrets (as it is now called) had a higher purpose, I fear that for many Alvarians, it has become a lure of temptation and power. Many of them nowadays are little more than cultists now.

attack_description: Has an attack that targets the hex directly behind an adjacent hex. It doesn’t provoke counterattacks and doesn’t move the attacker next to their target.
name: Binder
description: By infusing the bindings of Vori Texts with the profane power of the Rift, Binders tear open temporal gaps in reality, lashing out at their foes with planar tendrils.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Angel
description: The inquisition’s greatest belief is that angels still accompany their mission. The beings that aid the Templars in combat are but a mere imitation — a human soul willingly fused with winged armor, destined to continue the fight.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Apotheosis
description: A javelin in one hand and a pavise in the other, these battle suits embody the wrath of the Sun, crashing down upon those they deem unworthy. Bereft of mercy, they embrace the ideals that made the real angels abandon the Church: unbridled zealotry and intolerance for non-believers.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
movement_description: Teleports directly to destination hex, ignoring obstacles and traps.
name: Naiad
description:
Betwixt two realms, the Mycelium serves as a bridge, allowing passage between our world and the realm beyond it. As a result, young elementals merge with the flora and fauna of the Murmurwoods to take on physical forms.

Waterkin often choose the shape of naiads — spry, elusive, and ever-shifting, much like the element they embody.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
movement_description: Teleports directly to destination hex, ignoring obstacles and traps.
name: Brumal Naiad
description:
Water sustains life, but it can just as easily take it away. Cold, cruel and unyielding, a single shard of ice can spell the doom of a nation.

To a brumal naiad, only those who survive the winter deserve to endure.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Arbitrator
description: Heavily transfigured and rendered immobile, these immensely powerful warlocks serve Schism by inscribing Vori seals upon the riftwalkers her cult summons. Yet over time, they slowly unravel into something utterly grotesque.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Rift Arbitrator
description: Barely recognizable from their former selves, these arbitrators serve as floating control relays, capable of directing countless shoth at once. The strain they endure surpasses the limits of any mortal mind or body.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Bloated Arbitrator
description:
I struggle to comprehend the ancient Vori language that once tore open the Rift. But these grotesquely bloated arbitrators have no such trouble, wielding it to warp the barriers between our world and the eldritch realm beyond.

They will doom us all.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
movement_description: Teleports directly to destination hex, ignoring obstacles and traps.
name: Guile Infiltrator
description: Handpicked by Spymaster Caspair, guile infiltrators are selected for missions demanding extreme precision and the ability to carry out tasks without leaving a trace. They excel at manipulating external politics and managing debtors.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Dread Knight
description: A soul fused with its armor, dread knights exist by a single rule — to fight is to live, and to live is to fight.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Avatar of War
description: “And there went out another mount that was emerald: and power was given to them that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto them a great scythe.”

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Hollow Reaper
description: As carnage mounts, certain knights grow even more powerful, with each soul cleaved from their enemies being added onto their scythes. They inspire such terror that common folk liken them to death itself.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Cave Dragon
description: Born in the depths of their caves, dragons are ambitious beings of immense intelligence and power, with few equals in Jadame. Some have allied with Alvar in their pursuit of even greater heights.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Black Dragon
description: The Stygianscales, represented by “Queen” Amelchia, are pivotal players within Alvari politics, wielding raw strength and extensive ties among various broods and scales across the continent. Cunning and ever-prepared, they strive to unite Alvar under a new order.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Ashen Dragon
description:
Ashen Dragons are often misunderstood — viewed as weak by those who fail to grasp their true strength, yet perceived as excessively power-hungry because of it.

I hope to live long enough to meet and speak with an ashen wyrm; surely, they would have a fascinating story to tell.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Jasper Dancer
description: As glaive dancers grow more proficient, they are outfitted with armor enhanced by gems traded from their underground allies. After all, looks can kill.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Aureate Dancer
description: Eschewing gems in favor of refined gold, the Aureates embody everything others imagine dark elves to be — elegant, ambitious, deadly, and above all, using wealth as their greatest advantage both in negotiations and on the battlefield.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Crossbowman
description: Animal handling has always been a challenge for humans. However, those with a talent for ranged combat forge such strong bonds with their hawks that they move as one, guiding each other against their foes.

attack_description: Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
name: Marksman
description:
Neither blessings nor gentle arts win wars — metallurgy does.

The Church teaches self-perfection in all forms — soul, body, and steel. With a heavy crossbow in hand, the Order of the Anvil ensures their prayers strengthen the very weapons and armor they forge.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Dragonslayer
description: Dragon killing is not for the meek — or the sane. It demands risking life and limb against impossible odds. Yet, the lure of glory and riches ensures there are always those desperate or mad enough to try. The rare few who succeed become legends, their names etched into history forever.

attack_description: Has an attack that targets the hex directly behind an adjacent hex. It doesn’t provoke counterattacks and doesn’t move the attacker next to their target.
name: Herbomancer
description: Deep in the woods dwell those who venerate nature in all its forms. Blessed as its stewards, herbomancers are the envoys of the Mycelium, sent across Jadame to safeguard the natural order. Many seek them out for assistance in grasping the magical flow of Enroth.

attack_description: Has an attack that targets the hex directly behind an adjacent hex. It doesn’t provoke counterattacks and doesn’t move the attacker next to their target.
name: Sporemancer
description: All life in the Murmurwoods is interconnected. Those who understand this best become sporemancers — elders who nurture the forest, guiding the elementals that dwell within it and upholding its delicate balance.

attack_description: Has an attack that targets the hex directly behind an adjacent hex. It doesn’t provoke counterattacks and doesn’t move the attacker next to their target.
name: Murmurmancer
description: Some mancers believe that merely guiding the Mycelium is not enough — its protection must come first. Viewing outsiders as a constant threat, they weave their frustration into their magic, making their spells wildly unpredictable and dangerously volatile.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
movement_description: Teleports directly to destination hex, ignoring obstacles and traps.
name: Grand Shoth
description: Grand shoth are an experiment in binding. While some shoth are controlled through telepathy or communion, these creatures are bound purely though the Sacred Language.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
movement_description: Teleports directly to destination hex, ignoring obstacles and traps.
name: Unspeakable Shoth
description:
With the right incantations, shoth can be turned into incredibly precise and focused weapons, capable of striking without mercy.

…What happens if a spell scroll is torn off?

attack_description: Can attack enemies at any range.
name: Faun Archer
description:
In the dense forest of the Murmurwoods, silence reigns; long-range weaponry that doesn’t startle the inhabitants dominates. The fauns understand this well, using bows to hunt for food — and to deal with unwelcome visitors.

It is strongly advised to be their guest, not their target.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Faun Warrior
description: For some fauns, all outsiders are enemies and unworthy of a quick and silent death. They charge into battle driven by a single emotion: fury.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Vine Iriyad
description:
Betwixt two realms, the Mycelium serves as a bridge, allowing passage between our world and the realm beyond it. As a result, young elementals merge with the flora and fauna of the Murmurwoods to take on physical forms.

Vine iriyads are the earthkin’s preferred vessels for exploration.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Fungal Iriyad
description:
Elementalists say that each element has two aspects.

The first aspect of earth is that of nourishing soil, roots and foliage. Dendroids, treants and their kin are formidable yet protective — they are guardians of balance and peace.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
movement_description: Teleports directly to destination hex, ignoring obstacles and traps.
name: Faerie Dragon
description: They may appear sweet and cheerful, but faerie dragons are mischievous tricksters. One of the few creatures attuned to Enroth’s raw magical energies, they wield their power with playful cunning.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Wraith
description: Sometimes a soul is brought back with enough clarity to grasp its eternal entrapment in the living world. This harrowing realization of rage and despair gives rise to a wraith.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Aga'Shoth Rider
description: Aga’Shoth, meaning “Rift-Dweller of the Ground,” form a bond that intertwines the mind of its elven rider with its own. However, the boundary between beast and rider is tenuous, giving rise to peculiar habits.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Aga'Shoth Tamer
description: Centuries of exposure to the Rift’s energies beneath the ice have imbued the snow of the Frozen Vast with a lingering residue of power. This allows aga’shoth tamers to bind their mounts to Jadame itself, drawing upon a fragment of the land’s strength.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Aga'Shoth Mat'ha
description: Some riders undergo the ritual of Marash Mat’hash — “Blood Siblings” — which severs a portion of their mind to let it dwell in the Rift, enabling aga’shoth to cross into Jadame through a portal. Forever bound, the rider soon finds their psyche is irreparably shattered, tormented by the ceaseless whispers of their mount.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Giant Toad
description: The Regnan Archipelago, Daggerwound Islands, Jadame’s Jaws, and countless unnamed isles serve as breeding grounds for these giant, semi-aquatic creatures. Grumpy and territorial, they dominate large swaths of the continent’s coastal zones.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Reaver
description: The first time I witnessed a Reaver, I understood that the Hive was more than an anomaly — it had direction and purpose. They are not mere brutes, but predators hellbent on reaching the apex of the food chain.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Maniacal Reaver
description: They say it is gruesome to take pleasure in killing for its own sake. I disagree — the true horror lies in witnessing a reaver tear a battalion to shreds and hearing it cackle like a maniac, hungry for even more carnage.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Groll
description: Rock go boom. Stick go crash. Legend says these unpleasant and easily annoyed creatures were made from stone by dragons. But could stones ever be so short-tempered?

attack_description: Has an attack that targets the hex directly behind an adjacent hex. It doesn’t provoke counterattacks and doesn’t move the attacker next to their target.
name: Graverobber
description:
Graverobbers trail necromancers, assisting in acquiring skeletons and bodies for reanimation by any means — whether by exhuming the already-dead or creating new corpses.

Their constant exposure to deathly energies leaves them almost indistinguishable from the dead themselves.

attack_description: Has an attack that targets the hex directly behind an adjacent hex. It doesn’t provoke counterattacks and doesn’t move the attacker next to their target.
name: Merchant of Death
description: Procuring bodies for necromancers is a lucrative business, but souls are even more valuable. Merchants of death have mastered the alchemical arts needed to capture only the most prized and love-stricken samples.

attack_description: Has an attack that targets the hex directly behind an adjacent hex. It doesn’t provoke counterattacks and doesn’t move the attacker next to their target.
name: Kennelmaster
description: Vampires can be quite eccentric; their refusal to accept the flow of time leads them to hire resurrectionists. These kennelmasters ensure their employers always have a steady pack of dogs to hunt and play with.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Griffin
description: Griffins are not native to Jadame — they were brought from Karigor Isle and Antagarich by the Templars. A powerful symbol among the faithful, they soar high in the skies and embolden armies to venture deep into the unknown that surrounds their towns.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Temple Griffin
description: While the Sun serves as the official heraldry of the templars, many inquisitors proudly emblazon the griffin onto their banners, claiming its noble presence as a symbol of inspiration. The griffins among their ranks are outfitted with armor infused with the power of the Chalice, further bolstering their formidable presence in battle.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Guardian Griffin
description: The Order of the Sky is entrusted with the care and breeding of griffins. These intelligent and powerful creatures are not only heavily armored but also fiercely protective of their handlers. The bond between the griffins and the Order runs deep, with the beasts displaying an unwavering loyalty to those they serve, making them invaluable assets in the Templar ranks.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Hive Queen
description:
I struggled to understand the force behind the Hive until I encountered a Hive Queen. More devil than insect, she whispered of “Master Beelzebub” and his herald.

It was then that I realized what we were up against — and what it would take to win.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Hive Mother
description: A mockery of the maternal instinct, these “Mothers” empower the Dragonfly King’s followers by feeding them strange, glowing crystals. Over time, their “pups” mutate into new Hive breeds.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Enemies do not counterattack.
name: Hive Huntress
description: Personal lieutenants of the Dragonfly King, Huntresses are capable of independent and complex thought. Acting as pioneers for the Hive, once they find a suitable spot, they establish a nest for its future matriarch.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Inquisitor
description: Leaders, judges and executioners — the inquisitors embody the pinnacle of human resolve. Their unbreakable will often proves decisive in battle.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Mother Superior
description: Most military orders within the Church are led by a mother superior, acting as commander in the absence of higher authority. Their presence on the battlefield signals an inevitable advance — they will see it through.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Excommunicator
description: The Church upholds purity of soul above all else — those who falter face the excommunicators, whose gaze never fails to uncover heresy.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Fire Larva
description: A perversion of the natural cycle, fire larvae exist only to hatch and burst near another living being, unleashing a conflagration of fire and mutating energies — like a virus driven to spread its demonic will to the next host.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Ra'Shoth
description: Ra’Shoth, meaning “Small Rift-Dwellers” in the Vori language, are the most basic lifeforms to emerge from the Rift. Guided by simple instincts, they seek out a higher authority through telepathy and follow their commands without questions.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Stinging Ra'Shoth
description: Some Ra’Shoth have developed specialized synapses that enable them to discharge electrical currents from a distance. It is remarkable how adaptive life within the Rift seems to be.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Lich
description:
A self-risen undead bound to the materium through a phylactery and a rite prepared before death. Liches seek immortality and power in the living world.

On Jadame, they also delve into time-turning magic — necromancy is not the only way to persist in this world, after all.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Pestilent Lich
description:
Miasma is another form of eternal life — constantly shifting and changing, yet enduring. It’s no coincidence that deadly poisons and miraculous cures are often the same substance, administered in different amounts.

Perhaps life and death are not opposites, but two faces of one card.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Sanguine Lich
description:
Necromancers make the finest healers, for the force of life is simply the power of death rewound.

Yet there must be an agenda behind their study of time. Could it be that everything we know about the liches of the past — and everything we will know about them — is merely a deception of the present? Time will tell.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Hierophant
description: Hierophants serve as chaplains for the more secular Templars, reinforcing their faith and fortifying their resolve. It is said that with a single prayer, they can heal the wounds of an entire squadron.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Sun Herald
description: ”O! The Great Chalice, who watches over us, you are the remover of all diseases, the repository of peace: I bow to you. May you bless your devotees with the power to smite the faithless and the unholy.”

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Locust
description: Locusts serve as the Hive’s basic drones, tasked with delivering resources, building structures, and carrying the essences of those they consumed for further use.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Overgrown Locust
description: Sometimes, a Locust is imbued with so much demonic essence that it becomes highly aware of its surroundings. These overgrown drones are deployed following ravager parasites to prepare the Hive’s prey for harvest and eliminate anyone still resisting.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Harvester Locust
description: While common locusts are the builders, harvesters are the Hive’s “foragers.” These specialized drones scour the raid for resources, processing as much as they can to fuel the Hive’s needs.

attack_description: Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
name: Medusa Sculptor
description:
To many medusae, petrification is an art within an art, a revered act that grants an honored status to those chosen to be turned to stone in their society.

It raises a chilling question — how many of the Alvari statues I have passed in my life once walked these same streets?

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
movement_description: Teleports directly to destination hex, ignoring obstacles and traps.
name: Pyroboros
description: At first, I couldn’t believe the reports of “fire worms” evaporating forests. My doubts swiftly dispelled when my friend Ylwari shared the story of encountering a Pyroboros, turning swamps into a lake of lava.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Undead Pet
description:
Some necromancers reanimate elves and humans. Others choose companions truly dear to them, like loyal hounds.

Dogs feel no torment in undeath — is there a greater fate than to remain by their master’s side for eternity?

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Barghest
description:
Among the simple folk, it is believed that barghests abduct children who refuse to heed their parents, delivering them to vampiric lords who curse them with vampirism.

Of course, it’s just a folk legend… isn’t it?

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Armored Hound
description: Risen hounds are more precious than gold to certain vampires, treasured as armored guards and hunting companions. These pets remain as loyal and loving in undeath as they were in life.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Flaming Phoenix
description: Out of all the elements, fire is the most demanding — it can bring hope as easily as it can reduce everything to ash. A blazing phoenix signals a new chick in the nest, but it also makes them fiercely territorial.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Energy Phoenix
description:
As phoenixes age, the heat around them intensifies. In time, they grow cautious, their flames shifting to a brilliant blue, radiating raw energy.

To a scholar, they are a marvel — a sentient supernova on the brink of eruption.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Primal Remnant
description: Before time, truth, and magic, the world was primal chaos — so say Hksmilla’s followers. Some entities still seem to echo that ancient era.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Qilin
description:
Free and ever-present, the element of air takes many forms — the wind that carries a child’s laughter, the gust of smoke in battle, the breeze that steals a widow’s scarf.

Qilins embody all that such zephyrs represent — swift, graceful and ephemeral.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Mist Qilin
description: Guests of the druids and elementalists in the Murmurwoods may be fortunate enough to encounter a Mist Qilin. Gentle and carefree like a drifting breeze, they serve as a reminder that Jadame will always be a land of wonders and adventure.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Sentinel of Glory
description: These former allies of the Church of the Sun have abandoned it for an unclear reason. The claim is, they are “keepers of balance” — and when the Inquisitors shook it, they chose instead to serve the balance between the four scholars of magic.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Skeleton
description: Skeletons are the simplest product of necromancy, raised without elaborate rituals — just magic binding bones into a crude frame capable of basic movement and obedience.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Skeleton Warrior
description: With a little care, skeletons can retain memories of their lives as soldiers or fighters — stripped of personality but still skilled.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
movement_description: Teleports directly to destination hex, ignoring obstacles and traps.
name: Starchild
description: All four Scholars read the stars, but Naira has always been the closest to them. Her shadows, eerily resembling her, are cast by the stars — or are they? Do they rise from the ground, or are they messengers of the heavens? And if so, what secrets do they hold about our world?

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Mistress of Chains
description: When I encountered the elves who had embraced the path of Schism, they were unrecognizable. The powers of the Rift had twisted them into something alien — still in control, yet bound all the same.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Noble Cavalry
description:
The Order of Sunlight has one goal: to uphold the Church’s vision through chivalry and honor.

A noble, yet baseless claim.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Troglodyte
description: Blind and small, troglodytes are often seen by surface races as primitive creatures. However, their adaptability and deep knowledge of underground passages are no joke, and these are precisely why they play a crucial role in Alvar.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Infernal Troglodyte
description: Despite their physical frailty, many troglodytes display cunning by targeting their opponents’ weak points. Defeating a stronger foe grants them the title of a Shakkor — “the Infernal.”

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Toxic Troglodyte
description: Some troglodyte tribes have developed a green hue and spikes. Initially a disadvantage, it has quickly proven an asset as these Arla — “bold ones” — are born with poisonous blood lethal to any who try to harm them.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Hoplet
description: The ecosystem of the Murmurwoods is steeped in raw magic, flowing through Enroth. At times, it imbues the most unexpected creatures, resulting in this unique cross of fireflies and common hops.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Enemies do not counterattack.
name: Dawn Hoplet
description: Some scholars with a keen interest in botany claim that hops are known for releasing a strong, mind-clearing aroma at dawn. It stands to reason that these little creatures would mimic such behavior, blending both nature’s gift and their mystical influence.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Dusk Hoplet
description: Whenever nature and magic intertwine, the results are always unpredictable. Closer to their firefly origins, dusk hoplets release bursts of magical energy as the Sun sets and night begins to creep in. The spectacle is nothing short of breathtaking.

attack_description: Has an attack that targets the hex directly behind an adjacent hex. It doesn’t provoke counterattacks and doesn’t move the attacker next to their target.
name: Votary
description: By opening their minds further to the eldritch influence, votaries serve as the eyes of their mistress — and of whatever lurks within the Rift. I shudder to imagine what becomes of their psyche.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Abyssal Envoy
description: When an arbitrator’s psyche inevitably collapses, a gateway is torn open, allowing these monstrosities to spill into Jadame. Lyssara insists they are under her control, but I’m not convinced — they seem far too independent and… sentient.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Abyssal Overseer
description: Bound by enchanted chains, these creatures herald an age of great upheaval. A single glance upon them can drive one to madness and delusion. Worst of all, they seem to be mere watchers, acting on behalf of something far more powerful.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Abyssal Executor
description: I once escaped the cult of the Frozen Vasts myself, and I am now certain — the terrors of the deep are not to be trifled with. Whatever these poor elves have unleashed will bring calamity to Jadame, with only one warning of its coming: beware the Black Ice.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Vampire
description:
The origin of vampires remains a mystery to most. Powerful and vain, they see themselves as the pinnacle of creation.

The draconic society of Garrote Gorge, however, dismisses such imperious notions.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Enemies do not counterattack.
name: Vampire Lord
description:
Vampires tend to thrive in aristocratic circles rather than among commoners. It seems only logical — eternal life surrounded by opulence is far more spectacular.

The decadence of nobles fuels their midnight ascension into darkness.

attack_description: Has an attack that targets the hex directly behind an adjacent hex. It doesn’t provoke counterattacks and doesn’t move the attacker next to their target.
name: Vampire Scholar
description: Some vampires view their condition as an opportunity, delving into study of the powers hidden within blood. Their experiments make them dangerously unpredictable.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Hornet
description: A horrific mutation of the waspfolk, hornets were among the first creatures to fall prey to demonic corruption. With massive wings and formidable intellect, they have become a deadly air force in service to the Hive.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Chanter
description: Some of the waspkin retained a limited ability to speak. Twisted by the demonic powers they serve, they now chant the sweet lies about the caressing embrace and bliss in the arms of the Dragonfly King — their liege.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Stinger
description: As their mutations intensify, hornets gradually evolve into Stingers. Their jabs can pierce even the toughest hides, injecting a bio-magical cocktail of venom and demonic essence that kills their victims.

attack_description: Can attack enemies at any range.
name: Archangel
description:
The art of mimicking angels is the Church of the Sun’s most guarded secret, involving techniques beyond even their own understanding. It must have something to do with those heavily protected buildings they construct in their cities.

But, of course, that’s just a theory among us scholarly minds.

attack_description:
Can attack enemies at any range. Replaced with a weaker Melee attack if an enemy is adjacent. –50% Melee Damage.
Targets 3 or more hexes away take –10% Damage per hex (up to –50%).
name: Onyx Dancer
description: The dark elves of Alvar, the most populous race on Jadame, can be found nearly anywhere, primarily taking roles as spies, traders, and entertainers. With their cultural background, it is no surprise that Alvarian dark elves fill the ranks of a military branch that merges the art of blade dancing with glaive wielding.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
movement_description: Teleports directly to destination hex, ignoring obstacles and traps.
name: Unthinkable Shoth
description: It would seem that some shoth are fighting back against their bindings, partially unravelling in the process. This makes them more chaotic and more dangerous — and very efficient in some situations.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Crystal Iriyad
description:
Elementalists say that each element has two aspects.

The second aspect of earth is the stubborn, proud, and unyielding nature found at its foundation: stone. To come across a crystal iriyad is to face this unrelenting resistance to change — and an unavoidable delay in your journey, as they are fiercely territorial.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Gnat
description: Mutated to serve as the Hive’s foot soldiers, gnats are remnants of giant flies that once roamed the Ironsand Desert. Swift and annoying, they used to function as scouts, distractions for more important Hive members. However, the fragile bodies of the flies could not cope with these purposes — and swarms of gnats now roam Jadame on their own.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Ferocious Ra'Shoth
description: These red-crested Ra’Shoth are far more aggressive than others, defending themselves with sweeping tentacle strikes. However, they pose a real threat only when attacking in groups.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Minotaur
description: The Minotaurs’ seat of power in Jadame lies in the underground maze-town of Balthazar’s Lair, founded by Clan Balthazar. Renowned for their combat prowess and architectural mastery on the surface, they were among the first invited to join the Pact.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Minotaur Lord
description: To attain the rank of a lord, a minotaur must excel in their chosen profession. While combat, magic, and masonry are most common, it’s not unheard of to encounter a Lord Jeweler or Lord Moneyer.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Minotaur Vanguard
description: “The Vanguard” is a minotaur organization attracting young bulls with promises of adventure and a swift path to the rank of lord. These foot soldiers are impulsive yet efficient, often deployed to places where ruthlessness is considered an act of mercy.

attack_description: Can only attack adjacent enemies. Provokes counterattacks.
name: Thunder Qilin
description:
When the very first war came to the Murmurwoods, its echoes tore through the land — the sky split in two, and the fury of the elements was unleashed.

Thunder Qilins are lightning made flesh, striking down those who dare intrude.
